notes: cult.fit/careers 301-redirects to the Angular app at https://careers.cult.fit/cult/. Its main.3f2a2948bb3197cd.js posts a multipart form to https://public.zwayam.com/jobs/search with fields filterCri (JSON), domain and companyId; the base filterCri is {paginationStartNo, selectedCall:"sort", sortCriteria:{name:"modifiedDate",isAscending:false}, anyOfTheseWords:""}. Keyword is native-verified from the bundle: the search handler assigns filterCri.anyOfTheseWords = this.searchKeyword and emits {keyword} before calling searchJobsv1. Facet chips are stored in filterCri.facetSelectionString[<facet field name>] (keys taken from the response-driven facetedSearchConfig, so per-field keys are not confirmed here) - apply those locally, and page with paginationStartNo using the same body. The API requires the bundle's browser user agent (the generic scraper UA is WAF-stalled).
